title: Span.get must stay an unresolved attribute: hint via __getattr__, never a real get method
answers: why does span.get raise AttributeError instead of returning a value
hasattr(span, 'get') returns True on my span, how do I stop it
how should I add a dict-style hint for a span attribute that users try to call
agent tried span.get('name') and got a bare AttributeError
body:
Symptom: A user or coding agent calls span.get("name") (dict habit) and sees a bare "'Span' object has no attribute 'get'", or a library probes hasattr(span, "get") to test for a mapping.
Root cause: mlflow/entities/span.py:Span.__getattr__ is the hook that raises the guiding AttributeError only for name == "get"; other names get a generic AttributeError.
Fix pattern: Keep `get` unresolvable and steer through __getattr__. Do not add a real `get` method, because hasattr(span, "get") becomes True, getattr returns a bound method, and callable(span.get) is True while the message claims the attribute is missing.
Constraints: Applies to all span classes in mlflow/entities/span.py (LiveSpan, immutable Span, LazySpan, NoOpSpan). Subscript misuse is a separate hint in Span.__getitem__ and raises TypeError, not AttributeError.
Tests: tests/entities/test_span.py:test_span_get_raises_helpful_attribute_error asserts hasattr(...) is False and the message for attribute and call access on each class.
applies: Any span class or span-like wrapper in mlflow/entities/span.py; not for other entities that legitimately implement get.
says: Fetching a trace property using dictionary syntax gives an unhelpful error without guidance.
Show a helpful guidance message when developers try calling dictionary getter methods on traces.
Third-party libraries mistakenly detect trace objects as key-value dictionaries and fail during property access.
Provide clear guidance for trace attribute lookup without falsely pretending to be a mapping.
Coding assistants get stuck when querying trace attributes because the error lacks corrective suggestions.
search: Span classes in `mlflow/entities/span.py` must keep `get` unresolvable as a real method and instead raise an explanatory `AttributeError` via `__getattr__`. Implementing an actual `get` method would cause `hasattr(span, 'get')` to return True and expose a bound method, misleading tools probing for mapping interfaces. Applies to `Span`, `LiveSpan`, `LazySpan`, and `NoOpSpan`, while subscript misuse is handled separately in `Span.__getitem__` with a `TypeError`. Behavior is verified by `tests/entities/test_span.py:test_span_get_raises_helpful_attribute_error` asserting `hasattr` remains False and guiding messages appear on access.
